decisions.choice: Database-backed systems carousel with authenticated content settings
decisions.reason: Keeps every system discoverable in a compact overview while allowing administrators to manage all portfolio and global fields without editing source code

decisions.choice: Three-color portfolio palette: warm paper, near-black, and cobalt
decisions.reason: Creates visual cohesion and lets hierarchy come from typography and contrast rather than decorative color

decisions.choice: Editorial portfolio with warm neutral canvas, ink project gallery, and cobalt contact field
decisions.reason: Creates a distinctive, contemporary identity while keeping project work and contact intent primary
Keeps the first-run experience complete without stock imagery or external asset dependencies

decisions.choice: Outcome-led technical portfolio for Dennis Dizon
decisions.reason: Positions FileMaker delivery and IT infrastructure as a unified practice, grounded in quantified résumé results

decisions.choice: Discreet authenticated studio control in the public header
decisions.reason: Keeps portfolio administration accessible to the owner without presenting an obvious public-facing admin call to action

decisions.choice: Explicit password confirmation in account security forms
decisions.reason: Prevents accidental password changes caused by typing errors while preserving the established compact form pattern
